title: feat(mechanic): package.patch skill and a git.repo.test --live gate
description:
## .what

two mechanic skills a consumer (rhachet-roles-nheuron) paved, which every repo needs:

1. **`package.patch --package <name>@<version> --mode open|commit`** — wraps `pnpm patch` / `pnpm patch-commit`. drives pnpm's two interactive prompts ("choose which version to patch", "apply this patch to all versions?") through a pty with a coproc that answers each prompt only once it has drawn; keystrokes sent on a clock race the render and land in the search box. refuses to report "opened" for an edit dir pnpm never made.
2. **a live-gate flag for `git.repo.test`** — live cases gate on `TEST_LIVE=<service>`, and an env-var prefix (`TEST_LIVE=ses rhx git.repo.test …`) is not a paved shape. the consumer wrapped it as `rhx test.live --live ses <git.repo.test args>`. better as `git.repo.test --live ses,cloudflare`.

## .also seen

`git.repo.test` exports the test env's AWS_PROFILE into the jest process before setup files run; any live case that targets another org's account must clear it, and under jest that clear only reaches child processes if every spawn passes `env: process.env` (see ehmpathy/rhachet keyrack-source dispatch).

## .reference impl

`.agent/repo=.this/role=any/skills/{package.patch,test.live}.sh` in ehmpathy/rhachet-roles-nheuron.
